name: treeoflife
title: tree of life
blurb: every Bluesky DID hashes to one fixed species out of a real, ~120-species taxonomy — the same species for everyone, forever, no login and no randomness, just a pure function of the DID. type a handle and see it, and its network (mutuals, widened to follows), laid out as a real kingdom→phylum→class→order→family→genus→species tree. @ver.ooo asked for a globally stable Bluesky tree of life.
